applicability: Embedded and standalone web pages sharing Paseo localStorage and the plugin's remembered standalone look.
conditions: The pinned app writes its whole in-memory settings through the observed storage channel.
A matching writer/seen record describes the last settings or sidebar write.
exclusions: Frame-originated appearance changes are not adopted as standalone preferences.
Unobserved or nonmatching writer records use the existing explicitly documented content rules; they do not establish recorded provenance.
Storage or write-observation refusal does not certify successful restoration.
